network_calls.trigger: Opt-in usage/install events when telemetry_enabled is true
network_calls.purpose: Optional product diagnostics and install attribution; completely blocked when Zero-Telemetry / Offline Mode is active (default).

network_calls.trigger: Startup upload of sanitized panic report when telemetry_enabled is true
network_calls.purpose: Uploads redacted Rust panic location/message only if user opts in to telemetry; blocked by default.

network_calls.trigger: Startup/4h timer and Settings open when telemetry_enabled is true; manual 'Check Updates' and user-initiated 'Install Update' (plus release asset/signature download)
network_calls.purpose: Checks latest signed desktop release version and SHA-256 checksum (and downloads verified installer/signature on user-initiated update). Automatic checks are disabled in Zero-Telemetry / Offline Mode.

network_calls.trigger: Background localized add-on price check when telemetry_enabled is true, or when user opens Upgrade modal
network_calls.purpose: Displays localized GBP/USD/EUR pricing; passive background fetches are blocked in Zero-Telemetry / Offline Mode.

network_calls.trigger: Upgrade modal open when telemetry_enabled is true; uses local deterministic fallback variant A in Zero-Telemetry / Offline Mode
network_calls.purpose: Optional paywall variant assignment; blocked completely when Zero-Telemetry / Offline Mode is active (default).

network_calls.trigger: User-initiated Upgrade modal open only (never runs on startup or in background)
network_calls.purpose: Checks eligibility for a contextual upgrade discount coupon when the user explicitly opens the Upgrade modal.

network_calls.trigger: User-initiated Pro activation, OTP/QR pairing, --activate-token, or cached-account entitlement refresh; skipped when unactivated in Zero-Telemetry / Offline Mode
network_calls.purpose: Verifies Pro entitlement and issues short-lived Ed25519-signed device tokens; offline Ed25519 JWS tokens verify locally with zero network calls.

network_calls.trigger: User-initiated Password Breach Check in Privacy tab
network_calls.purpose: Checks k-anonymity 5-hex SHA-1 prefix locally; plaintext passwords and full hashes never leave the device.

network_calls.trigger: User-initiated Support form submission in Settings
network_calls.purpose: Sends user-authored support message when explicitly submitted.
